from typing import NamedTuple

from server import ServerConfig


class WorkerConfig(NamedTuple):
    host: str
    port: int
    timeout_s: float
    use_tls: bool
    workers: int


def worker_from(server: ServerConfig, workers: int) -> WorkerConfig:
    return WorkerConfig(server.host, server.port, server.timeout_s, server.use_tls, workers)
